Chapter 669: Chapter 9: Lin Yuan'S Adventure (5000 Words, Please Subscribe)_2

Chapter 669: Chapter 9: Lin Yuan’s Adventure (5000 words, please subscribe)_2

Even if a portion escaped, the vast majority of Ninth Rank Alien Race would still perish at the hands of Human Civilization Evolvers.

In the eyes of the Alliance formed by the Insect Race, Tianyu Clan, and other Peak Clans, their own losses were somewhat mitigated by preserving a portion of their powerful Avatars.

But the gains on the side of Human Civilization would be even greater.

Seeing this,

they decided to go all in.

They would rather bear the losses themselves than let Human Civilization benefit in the slightest.

...

“Galaxy Master, this is all because of the Galaxy Master!”

This particular Ninth Rank Evolver thought of that majestic figure and couldn’t help trembling.

If it weren’t for the absolute force of suppression from the Galaxy Master, how could so many Ninth Ranks be forced into such a dire situation by a mere Ninth Rank Evolver from Human Civilization?

“However, I’ve hidden all my Secret Treasure Weapons and fortunes in a hidden corner of the Secret Realm, hoping they will still be there the next time the Secret Realm opens…”

This particular Ninth Rank Evolver thought to himself that without his Secret Treasure Weapons, his combat power would plummet, and the probability of breaking through the blockade of Human Civilization and escaping was next to nil.

The main issue was that the Xuanhuang Secret Realm exerted an exceedingly strong spatial constriction, greatly impairing their best skills of teleportation and spatial movement.

Moreover, after entering the peripheral area, the nearby space had to be stable in order for one to be ejected.

As for hiding the Treasure Weapons in the inner area and then attempting to forcefully break through the blockade of Human Civilization…

The corpses of Ninth Rank beings are also precious resources, especially those of special life forms, which are valued in terms of millions of Cubic Universe Crystals.

…

Time passed.

Another half a year went by.

In the peripheral area of the Xuanhuang Secret Realm.

Lin Yuan and other Ninth Rank Evolvers from Human Civilization were successfully ejected at the very last moment of the Secret Realm’s closure.

Whoosh.

Lin Yuan’s figure appeared under the starry sky.

Gradually, other Ninth Rank Evolvers from Human Civilization started to appear next to him.

“Galaxy Master, I’ll be taking my leave first,”

“If it weren’t for the Galaxy Master on this expedition to the Secret Realm, how could our Human Civilization have dominated those Different Species?”

“Hahahaha, it was truly exhilarating…”

One after another, the Ninth Rank Evolvers from Human Civilization bid goodbye to Lin Yuan before leaving on their own.

Lin Yuan also merged into the depths of the Spatial Layers, flying toward the direction of the Milky Way Main Star.

Simultaneously,

a thread of Lin Yuan’s consciousness followed the Xuanhuang Seal and descended to the deepest part of the Xuanhuang Secret Realm.

As the master of the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, even without physically entering, he could send an Incarnation of his consciousness using the power of the Seal.

“Master.”

The Six-Armed Silhouette stood respectfully there.

“How is it?”

Lin Yuan asked directly.

Tasking the Six-Armed Silhouette to eliminate those Ninth Rank Different Species in the core areas of the inner region was natural for Lin Yuan, as it was an act the Six-Armed Silhouette was quite familiar with and had done many times before.

“Master, there are no outsiders left in the Secret Realm now,” the Six-Armed Silhouette immediately responded.

No outsiders meant that those Ninth Rank Different Species, which were not ejected to the Main Universe in the peripheral area, had all perished.

“These are the corpses of those outsiders.”

The Six-Armed Silhouette waved his hand, and over eight thousand corpses materialized in front of him.

The Xuanhuang Secret Realm had two kinds of eradication forces, one was complete eradication where both the physical body and soul would be obliterated.

The other was the eradication of the soul, which would only erase the soul but leave the physical body intact.

Usually, the Six-Armed Silhouette would opt for complete eradication, as the physical bodies of the outsiders were of no use to him.

But this time, under Lin Yuan’s instructions, the Six-Armed Silhouette chose soul eradication.

“These…” Lin Yuan looked at the over eight thousand bodies of the Ninth Rank Different Species, each one a Cosmic Crystal.

The physical bodies of Ninth Rank life forms, having undergone countless refinements, contained blood, flesh, and bones that were considered to be nine-star cosmic rare treasures.

And those were just the ordinary life forms of Ninth Rank; if they were special life forms of Ninth Rank, their value could be tens to hundreds of times greater.

“These bodies must not be exposed, and they shall serve as sustenance for my ‘Primordial Yellow Physique’ cultivation,” Lin Yuan thought to himself.

He had no psychological burden in consuming these bodies, as all were Different Species of the Cosmic Starry Skies.

Human Civilization often hunted these special life forms to create delicacies, which were also very popular.

And the cultivation of the ‘Primordial Yellow Physique’ required a massive amount of external resources, which was not limited to Xuanhuang Crystals; any energy-containing item could be devoured and absorbed by the Primordial Yellow Physique.

“Also, there are the Secret Treasure Weapons.”

With another wave, over ten thousand Secret Treasure Weapons appeared.

Although the Ninth Rank Different Species entering the Xuanhuang Secret Realm would not carry any valuable Secret Treasure Weapons, they would definitely bring one or two decent weapons to maintain their combat power.

Individually, one or two weapons might not seem much.

But when added together, the Secret Treasure Weapons of over eight thousand Ninth Rank Different Species totaled close to twenty thousand, all belonging to Secret Treasure Weapons of Ninth Rank level.

The sheer value astonished Lin Yuan.

“Lucky my True Spiritual Body can cultivate the ‘Primordial Yellow Physique,’ otherwise it would take who knows how long to bring these out.”

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

Like the corpses of the Ninth Rank Different Species, the nearly twenty thousand Secret Treasure Weapons in front of Lin Yuan could not be taken out either, as each had its own unique characteristics. Once taken out, there was a risk of being recognized.

This, in turn, could expose Lin Yuan’s identity as the master of the Xuanhuang Secret Realm.

Other than using them for the cultivation of the ‘Primordial Yellow Physique,’ Lin Yuan had other uses for these bodies and Secret Treasure Weapons.
